title: Alert system tables are in Public Preview
body:
The `system.alert` schema is in [Public Preview](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). This schema contains the `alerts` table, which records the configuration of every alert, and the `alert_evaluation_history` table, which records one row per alert evaluation. Use these tables to audit alert definitions, analyze evaluation trends, and monitor alert workloads at scale.

See [Alert system tables reference](/aws/en/admin/system-tables/alerts).
